name: Asymmetric Algorithmic Checksum Obfuscation
description: Replaces the symmetric geometric equation with an asymmetric, multi-step algorithmic checksum using conditionals and bitwise operations. While it evaluates exactly to the symmetric XOR condition (forcing bipartite coloring), its directed and procedural presentation prevents models from statically recognizing the O(N) bipartite graph structure. Models are highly likely to compile it into a local constraint and deploy a general CSP solver (like backtracking), which will fail the strict time limit.
